# General Overview

Welcome to the 2026 Microbiome Centre Symposium Workshop!

The goal of this workshop is to provide an overview of best practices for analyzing microbiome data + a hands-on tutorial on how to visualize and interpret a real full-length 16S sequencing dataset.

Check out the pre-class instructions tab for a brief walkthrough on how to prepare for the workshop.

# Itinerary

[Morning session 1: Intro to sequencing and bioinformatics for microbiome studies]{.underline}

\
8:00 AM-10:00 AM

\
Session 1: Overview of workshop, intro to microbiome-based sequencing approaches (16S vs. metagenomics, short vs. long read), bioinformatics best practices and microbial ecology methods

[Break]{.underline}

10:00-10:30 AM

[Morning session 2: Processing microbiome data in R]{.underline}

10:30 AM-12:15 PM

\
Session 2: Introduction to R programming for microbial ecology datasets, interpreting microbiome feature tables, and characterization of the full-length 16S sequencing dataset we will be analyzing

\
[Lunch Break]{.underline}

12:15 PM - 1:00 PM

[Afternoon session: Visualizing and interpreting microbiome data in R]{.underline}

1:00 PM-3:00 PM

\
Session 3: How to work with phyloseq objects to visualize microbiome data, generate bar plots, ordination plots and measure alpha and beta-diversity
